title: Filesystem path-check/read TOCTOU under adversarial concurrent mutation
description: The implementation checks symlink components and resolved-path confinement before later opening the same pathname via Path.read_bytes(). A concurrent adversary capable of mutating the filesystem namespace could replace the path between validation and open. Exact digest checks still protect content identity unless substituted bytes match, but strict path/inode identity is not proven.
required_before_runtime_qualification: define the runtime filesystem mutation/adversary model
if concurrent namespace mutation is in scope, bind path validation and byte read to one opened file descriptor using no-follow semantics where supported
verify opened object identity/type with fstat or equivalent before consuming bytes
add adversarial race/fault tests appropriate to the target runtime
obtain fresh runtime-qualification evidence; Slice 1 construction evidence cannot satisfy this finding
blocks: runtime qualification until explicitly resolved or formally scoped out by a preregistered runtime threat model
any production-readiness claim that assumes adversarial filesystem namespace integrity without evidence
